title: Studio English Foundations I: Garments, Tools, and Classroom Language
description: A first-semester ESP module that introduces fashion-study identity language, studio routines, garment vocabulary, visual description, and short portfolio-ready writing.
learning_goals: Build beginner-accessible English routines connected to Fashion Design coursework.
Develop confidence with core studio vocabulary, simple descriptions, and guided self-introductions.
Prepare learners to produce short written and spoken design-related outputs.
professional_outcomes: Students can explain who they are as Fashion Design students in simple English.
Students can understand and use recurring studio and coursework vocabulary.
Students can begin building short portfolio-friendly written artifacts.
language_outcomes: Use sentence frames for self-introduction, preference, and learning goals.
Recognize high-frequency course, studio, and design vocabulary.
Write short guided responses with clear meaning and basic accuracy.
